items.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
items.description: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

items.title: Trump faces growing backlash over plans to import diesel from Russia
items.description: Both Republican and Democratic lawmakers have criticised the deal, which was announced weeks before the US midterm elections.

items.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
items.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

items.title: American ranchers wrestle with soaring costs - and their loyalty to Trump
items.description: Many farmers in states that backed the president say they are being hit from all sides, with the crucial midterm elections just weeks away.

items.title: Mourners killed by Kenya police at ex-PM's national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds
items.description: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.

items.title: Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires
items.description: The critically endangered apes were rescued from intense wildfires that destroyed their habitat in August and September.

items.title: Indian opposition leaders march to top court to demand election chief resign
items.description: The march follows a chaotic weekend in Delhi which saw thousands of protesters being detained by police.

items.title: Pupil arrested after two teachers shot at French school
items.description: A 14-year-old was detained after the middle-school principal and teacher were injured.

items.title: Iconic Australian band Powderfinger announce first tour in 17 years
items.description: The band, who announced their reunion last week, say they are "absolutely ecstatic" to be playing together again.

items.title: Women's billion-dollar boom leaves players behind, says Fifpro
items.description: Women's football is on course to become a billion-dollar industry, but many professional players are still earning low wages, working on insecure contracts and experiencing rising psychological stress, a Fifpro survey indicates.

items.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
items.description: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

items.title: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says
items.description: The PM was speaking after violent attacks at Polish schools this week left one dead and others injured.

items.title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says
items.description: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 305 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
items.description: It is the third time this week that Ukraine has targeted Russian tech giant Yandex, forcing the company to suspend its operations.

items.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
items.description: The 71-year-old pontiff said the nodule was identified "at a very early stage".

items.title: Riyadh airport attacks another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
items.description: While the physical damage from Houthi attacks can be quickly repaired, the Saudi reputation for stability is taking a battering.

items.title: Inside the room: What it was like to be with Blackpink's Lisa as race scandal erupted
items.description: Film-maker Sue Kim talks about having unprecedented access to K-Pop idol Lisa Manobal at her most candid.

items.title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
items.description: A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and civilian resistance.

items.title: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago - why are they resuming now?
items.description: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed, but experts suggest officials are reading the country wrong.

items.title: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
items.description: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.
